items.title: Interview scheduled
items.caption: The Activity timeline shows Interview Scheduled, the latest appointment details, and its Manage action.

callouts.label: Interview Scheduled
callouts.body: The Activity timeline shows the current Interview Scheduled stage.

callouts.label: Appointment details
callouts.body: The latest scheduled interview includes its date, time, and status.

callouts.label: Manage appointment
callouts.body: Open this scheduled interview's appointment dialog.

items.title: Manage an appointment
items.caption: The appointment dialog shows the current appointment and keeps Reschedule, Cancel appointment, and Done in one action row.

callouts.label: Current appointment
callouts.body: Status, date, and time remain visible while choosing the next action.

callouts.label: Appointment actions
callouts.body: Reschedule, Cancel appointment, and Done share one row.

items.title: Choose the stage after cancellation
items.caption: Cancellation defaults to Move to Reschedule Needed and also allows the current stage to be kept.

callouts.label: Default stage change
callouts.body: Move to Reschedule Needed is selected by default.

callouts.label: Keep current stage
callouts.body: Operators can cancel the appointment without changing the pipeline stage.

callouts.label: Explicit confirmation
callouts.body: The dialog states the stage result before cancellation is confirmed.

items.title: Cancelled appointment and reschedule state
items.caption: The Activity timeline shows the cancelled interview, Manage on the latest scheduled interview, and the Reschedule Needed stage.

callouts.label: Cancelled interview
callouts.body: The Activity timeline records the cancelled appointment.

callouts.label: Manage appointment
callouts.body: Manage remains with the latest scheduled interview.

callouts.label: Reschedule Needed stage
callouts.body: The Activity timeline shows the updated Reschedule Needed stage.

items.title: Egg donor application review
items.caption: The review step shows the attached profile photo and explains when uploaded files are saved.

callouts.label: Review and submit
callouts.body: The applicant reaches the final review step before submission.

callouts.label: Upload status
callouts.body: The page explains that file uploads are saved when the application is submitted.

callouts.label: Profile photo attached
callouts.body: The application summary lists one profile photo file for review.

items.title: Egg and sperm donor lists
items.caption: The donor list separates Egg Donors and Sperm Donors; the active Egg Donors view shows two demo records.

callouts.label: Separate donor tabs
callouts.body: Egg Donors and Sperm Donors have distinct list views.

callouts.label: Egg donor records
callouts.body: The active Egg Donors view displays donor numbers and contact fields.

items.title: Donor stage reporting
items.caption: Stage reporting is configured for donor events with a local test webhook and separate Egg donor and Sperm donor mapping views.

callouts.label: Donor stage events
callouts.body: Donor stage events are enabled while surrogate stage events remain off.

callouts.label: Local test webhook
callouts.body: The outbound destination is a loopback URL used for local testing.

callouts.label: Optional hashed PII
callouts.body: Hashed email and phone fields are enabled for this configuration.

callouts.label: Donor mapping views
callouts.body: Egg donors and Sperm donors have separate mapping tabs.

items.title: Outbound delivery QA example
items.caption: QA example: the Activity view records a qualified Egg donor Application Submitted event delivered to the configured local receiver; this is not a real Zapier delivery.

callouts.label: Qualified donor event
callouts.body: Egg donor, Default, and Application Submitted identify the mapped event.

callouts.label: Delivered locally
callouts.body: The status confirms delivery to the configured local receiver.

callouts.label: Unmapped event skipped
callouts.body: An event without a mapping is marked Skipped.

items.title: Website donor record
items.caption: The created donor record shows a profile photo, Source Website, and a New stage for the demo applicant.

callouts.label: Created donor record
callouts.body: The donor number and New stage are visible in the record header.

callouts.label: Profile photo
callouts.body: The donor photo appears beside the stage action.

callouts.label: Website source
callouts.body: Contact Information records the donor source as Website.

items.title: Egg and sperm donor form routes
items.caption: Form routing shows separate QA routes that create Sperm donor and Egg donor records; both routes are mapped and remain editable.

callouts.label: Configuration tabs
callouts.body: Incoming leads, Form routing, Stage reporting, and Activity remain available in one configuration dialog.

callouts.label: Distinct donor records
callouts.body: The two routes create Sperm donor and Egg donor records respectively.

callouts.label: Mapped routes
callouts.body: Both QA routes show Mapped status.

callouts.label: Editable routes
callouts.body: Each configured route keeps its Edit route action.

items.title: Preview a stage transition
items.caption: The schedule dialog previews Reschedule Needed → Interview Scheduled and confirms the appointment and stage update together.

callouts.label: Stage transition preview
callouts.body: Review Reschedule Needed → Interview Scheduled before saving.

callouts.label: Schedule and update stage
callouts.body: Confirm the appointment and stage change together.
